ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “COASTAL FOOD WEB.” On the left side, “Menhaden” is shown below “Striped Bass.” A curved arrow points from Menhaden upward toward Striped Bass, showing that striped bass eat menhaden. Reasoning: If the number of striped bass decreases, then there are fewer predators eating menhaden. With less predation, the menhaden population would tend to increase.
